archetypes.name: deps-safety
archetypes.rationale: /deps consumes untrusted issue text before proposing GitHub mutations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /deps trust boundary and mutation gate. Focus on untrusted issue content handling, endpoint validation, approval sequencing, redaction, and whether any path can mutate GitHub before approval. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: deps-edge-rules
archetypes.rationale: Dependency edge direction and in-flight skip behavior are the highest-risk correctness surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review dependency edge normalization, explicit-reference parsing, cycle detection, duplicate handling, partial-audit blocking, and apply-time revalidation. Check that in-flight or busy clients are skipped without auto-flipping and mutable REGULAR clients can still depend on in-flight blockers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: deps-cli-tests
archetypes.rationale: The new CLI spans gh reads, block-issue writes, topology docs, and skill prompt contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review CLI registration, docs and topology integration, and offline test coverage. Pay attention to generator behavior for the new skill runtime authority and whether apply uses the expected block-issue helper path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
